html:
As we wrap up Women’s History Month, it’s important we take a moment to recognize the powerful women behind Alert and even our sister brand, Nexa Receptionists. Thank you to this amazing roster of leaders, and to all of you across the organization, for your work and dedication, and all that you do to improve the experiences of our clients and teammates, day in and day out.

  • Adrian Ruiz, Call Center Manager
  • Alba Cedillos, Call Center Manager

Kicking Off A Series Of Women In Leadership Profiles

Throughout the remainder of this year, we’ll continue to recognize the achievements of women across our organization with a profile series that spotlights their accomplishments, professional paths and best career advice. We hope you’ll follow along.
